notes: transparent PETG; two 150x70x285 mm bag pockets split by a 2 mm divider, each open as a 70x285 mm doorway through its right (+X) wall, with a 6.5 mm (~1/4 in) tubing exit hole per pocket low in the left (-X) wall (bottom 6.5 mm above the floor); closed top (the 2 mm ceiling closes solid over the channel, whose top sits one wall thickness below the box top), with a constant-width rod hang channel (rod diameter plus clearance) cut into the faces of the front wall/divider/back wall: a back-edge horizontal run that curves down through a rounded bend (both walls arcs, the curve maximized to the run-to-cradle drop so it flows directly into the cradle with no straight vertical drop) into a rounded center cradle, for one 1/8 in stainless rod through both bags' top loops, slid in from the +X back; the rod ends extend 6 mm past each outer wall into a boss whose outer surface is the channel cross-section grown by one wall thickness (a uniform 2 mm shell hugging the channel, open at the +X mouth) with a 2 mm plug past each tip capturing the rod along Y; outer envelope 154x162x289 mm including the rod-end bosses
